unresolved: Right-side vertical chain (2940/340/1200/340/2940) conflicts with drawn corridor clear ~1470mm; left chain (250/1500) matches drawing and was used
Top dimension chain sums to 14760 (not 15000); window W_N3 kept at drawn pixels x1480-1700
No staircase shown on either plan; floor-to-floor connectivity not representable from evidence

Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.
